text:
anya: Filing follow-up from the ETL incident overnight — recurring span drops + aggregator mismatch. Need owners, short fixes, and long-term checks.
ops-bot: Incident tag INC-2026-0424-02 created. Alerts routed to #eng-oncall.
jordan: Saw consumer backlog starting ~01:45 UTC; reprocessing overlapped with nightly compaction and caused CPU contention.
nina: Hot keys in session bucketing are the most likely trigger. Some partitions spiked and caused KV eviction which dropped non-root spans.
rahul: I'll own a short-term mitigation: add small in-memory buffer + backpressure throttle in consumer. ETA 6h for staging patch. Owner=rahul.
anya: rahul 1 add a dashboard panel for consumer buffer occupancy and reprocessing rate. Owner=rahul, due=1965243600, status=todo.
jordan: I'll revert the bucketing change in a feature-flagged way and implement weighted hashing. ETA 48h dev + 12h canary. Owner=jordan.
infra-bot: Reminder: nightly ETL runs at 02:00 UTC; consider shifting or reducing parallelism during the next deploy.
nina: For correctness: propose per-window row-count assertions and CRC checksums between source and aggregator. I can sketch the job. Owner=nina, due=1965320000.
anya: Add alerts: span-loss rate >0.05% over 10m and aggregator delta >1% for two consecutive windows. Update runbook with rollback steps.
rahul: quick config I pushed to staging: "consumer.max_inflight=200, buffering.ms=100". Monitoring looks healthy so far.
jordan: I'll post PR for the bucketing revert and weighted hash algorithm by EOD.
anya: Action list recap: rahul short-term buffering + dashboard; jordan revert + weighted hashing; nina checksums + nightly diff; ops adjust alerts and runbook. Put PR links in the follow-up doc and update the remediation spreadsheet.
ops-bot: Follow-up sync scheduled at 1965243600 UTC (agenda: deploy plan, validation checks, rollback).
anya: Thanks all — please leave single-line updates here if you hit blockers.
